insider_transactions.details: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 1,75,680 equity share of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited, representing its balance 40% equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from existing equity shareholders of Power-one and shall issue and allot 1,76,000 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Share (CCPS A3) to the sellers as non-cash consideration. Upon completion of the aforesaid transaction, Power-One shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, we wish to inform the exchange that, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company has entered into a Share Swap Agreement on 18th October 2026, in terms of the said agreement IL JIN shall acquire 23,401 equity shares of Ascent Circuits representing the balance 1.50% of its equity stake on fully dilutive basis, from Ms. Manju Thomas and shall issue and allot 13,120 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS A2) of an issue price of Rs. 10,000 per CCPS A2 (Including a Premium amount of Rs. 9,990 per CCPS A2) to Ms. Manju Thomas as non-cash consideration. Upon Completion of the aforesaid transaction, Ascent Circuits shall become wholly owned subsidiary of IL JIN and the Company.

announcements.summary: We hereby inform the exchange that the Board of Directors of IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (Formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited) at its meeting held on 16th October 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Satendra Singh as Chief Executive Officer and Whole Time Director of IL JIN with effect from 16th October 2026 for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years. Further, the Board of IL JIN has also noted the cessation of Mr. Sanjay Kumar Arora as Whole Time Director of IL JIN with effect from close of business hours on 16th October 2026.
Amber Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
